title: The Hungry Doorway
text: A doorway standing alone in a field, with nothing behind it but more field. Through it, though, the field is night: a black sky, cold stars, the same grass silver with frost. The air that comes through smells of earth and something hungry.

options.label: Send through whoever is carrying least, so they can bring back the most.

outcomes.text: They come back with arms full and frost in their hair, and will not say what they saw.
They come back with their eyes wrong. Something of the night side clings to them and will not let go.

options.label: The most armoured goes through first, trusting their iron to protect them.

outcomes.text: Whatever waits on the other side cannot get through all that iron. It tries, as the dents prove.

options.label: Close the door on the night, before whatever is hungry comes through.

outcomes.text: It closes far too easily. That night a cold draught blows into camp from nowhere, and nobody sleeps.
It closes far too easily. Behind you, from the night side, something knocks.

options.label: The Conjurer calls something through from the night side, hoping it is small.

outcomes.text: Something small and willing comes through. It rides at the Conjurer's shoulder into the next fight.
Something comes through, and it is not small.
